title: Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026
summary: Amends: Payment and Settlement Systems Act 2007, Income-tax Act 2025, Finance Act 2026...

items: Amends: Payment and Settlement Systems Act 2007, Income-tax Act 2025, Finance Act 2026
Foreign-company capital-goods tax exemption (electronics contract mfg) sunset moved: 2030-31 → **31 Mar 2041**
**UPI MDR provision**: enables MDR on e-payment modes outside a "negative list" — could end UPI's free-for-merchants status (current MDR: credit cards ~1.5%, debit up to 0.9%, UPI free)
New Entry 13F (Sch. IV, IT Act 2025): 15-year tax exemption for foreign cos trading rough diamonds via Special Notified Zones, 1 Oct 2026–31 Mar 2041

blocks.content:
🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Possible end of UPI's free-MDR status; rough-diamond SNZ exemption window (2026–2041).

⏰ Status: Bill introduced, not yet passed — UPI still free for merchants as of source date.
